missions.title: Inspect File Permissions
missions.description: Learn how Linux permission octets work and discover an insecure world-readable permission issue.
missions.descriptionAr: تعلم آلية أذونات نظام لينكس بالرموز الثمانية واكتشف ثغرة ملف متاح للقراءة من الجميع.
learningObjectives: Understand the Unix permission model (Read, Write, Execute for User, Group, Others)
Use `ls -la` and `stat` to inspect access modes
Locate world-readable sensitive assets in the active sandbox
missions.threatModel: Excessive read permissions on system configuration files allow low-privileged local users to harvest credentials.
missions.taskInstructions: Launch the isolated terminal lab. Explore the filesystem and inspect the checklist file in `/home/student/audit_checklist.txt`. Locate the discovery flag.
missions.taskInstructionsAr: قم بتشغيل معمل الطرفية المعزول. تصفح مسارات النظام وافحص قائمة التدقيق في `/home/student/audit_checklist.txt`. استخرج راية الاكتشاف.

hints.title: File inspection command
hints.content: Use `ls -la /home/student/` or `cat /home/student/audit_checklist.txt` to read the file content.

missions.remediationGuidance: Ensure all files containing sensitive operational information are restricted to 0640 or 0600.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Identify Insecure SUID Configuration
missions.description: Discover binaries with SUID bits set that have excessive write permissions.
missions.descriptionAr: اكتشاف الملفات التنفيذية التي تحتوي على بت SUID مع صلاحيات كتابة مفرطة.
learningObjectives: Understand SetUID (4000) execution dynamics
Identify how world-writable SUID binaries lead to privilege escalation
Inspect permissions of `/usr/local/bin/backup_tool`
missions.threatModel: If an attacker can write to a SUID binary executed with root rights, they can overwrite the payload and execute arbitrary code as root.
missions.taskInstructions: Audit `/usr/local/bin/backup_tool`. What is the 4-digit octal permission currently assigned to it? (Enter the 4-digit octal permission, e.g., 4777).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: قم بمراجعة الملف `/usr/local/bin/backup_tool`. ما هي الصلاحية الثمانية المكونة من 4 أرقام الممنوحة له حالياً؟ (أدخل مثلاً 4777).
missions.remediationGuidance: Never allow write permissions (chmod o-w, g-w) on SUID binaries. SUID binaries should strictly be 4755 or 4750 owned by root.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Remediate Insecure File Permissions
missions.description: Fix the insecure permissions on /etc/shadow and /var/www/html/config.php in the live lab.
missions.descriptionAr: أصلح الصلاحيات الخطرة على ملف /etc/shadow وملف /var/www/html/config.php في المعمل المباشر.
learningObjectives: Use `chmod` to harden vulnerable permissions
Set `/etc/shadow` to secure permissions (0640 or 0600)
Remove world-write permissions from `/var/www/html/config.php` (set to 0640 or 0644)
missions.threatModel: World-readable shadow files expose password hashes for offline cracking; world-writable config files allow defacement and DB hijacking.
missions.taskInstructions: In your active lab session, run chmod to secure `/etc/shadow` (e.g. `chmod 0640 /etc/shadow`) and `/var/www/html/config.php` (e.g. `chmod 0640 /var/www/html/config.php`). Then click "Grade Lab State" to automatically verify environment remediation.
missions.taskInstructionsAr: في معملك النشط، نفذ أمر chmod لتأمين `/etc/shadow` و `/var/www/html/config.php`. ثم انقر على "تحقق من حالة المعمل" لفحص المعالجة تلقائياً.
missions.remediationGuidance: Linux systems should automate permission audits using CIS benchmarks or auditd.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Investigate Authentication Logs
missions.titleAr: التحقيق في سجلات المصادقة لنظام لينكس
missions.description: Investigate /var/log/auth.log to discover an unauthorized SSH brute-force breach.
missions.descriptionAr: تحليل ملف سجلات المصادقة /var/log/auth.log لاكتشاف هجوم تخمين SSH ناجح واختراق النظام.
learningObjectives: Parse Linux SSH authentication logs
Correlate repeated `Failed password` events followed by `Accepted password`
Identify the malicious source IP and retrieved root flag
missions.threatModel: Lack of Fail2ban or rate-limiting on SSH port 22 allows automated password spraying and credential stuffing.
missions.taskInstructions: Launch the Auth Log Lab. Review `/var/log/auth.log`. Find the IP address that conducted the brute-force attack and compromised the deploy account, then read the flag in `/root/flag.txt`.
missions.taskInstructionsAr: شغل معمل سجلات المصادقة. راجع `/var/log/auth.log` وحدد الآي بي المهاجم ثم استخرج الراية من `/root/flag.txt`.
missions.remediationGuidance: Enforce SSH key authentication only (`PasswordAuthentication no`), change default SSH port, and deploy fail2ban.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Interpret IP Addresses and Subnets
missions.titleAr: تحليل وحساب عناوين IP والشبكات الفرعية
missions.description: Master CIDR notation, network boundaries, and usable host calculations for security zoning.
missions.descriptionAr: إتقان حسابات CIDR وحدود الشبكات وعناوين الأجهزة القابلة للاستخدام لتقسيم المناطق الأمنية.
learningObjectives: Calculate subnet masks from CIDR notation (/24, /27, /29)
Determine the broadcast address and number of usable hosts
Design isolated management VLANs
missions.threatModel: Improper subnet sizing can result in mixed-trust network zones where public-facing servers share collision/broadcast domains with databases.
missions.taskInstructions: Given the subnet 192.168.10.64/27: What is the total number of USABLE host IP addresses available for servers? (Enter the exact number).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: بالنظر إلى الشبكة الفرعية 192.168.10.64/27: ما هو العدد الدقيق لعناوين الأجهزة الصالحة للاستخدام (Usable Hosts)؟

hints.title: Usable host formula
hints.content: Formula is 2^(32 - prefix) - 2. For /27, host bits = 32 - 27 = 5.

missions.remediationGuidance: Allocate micro-segmented subnets with smallest required CIDR prefixes to limit blast radius.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Analyze PCAP Traffic & Cleartext Leaks
missions.titleAr: تحليل ملف PCAP وتسريب البيانات غير المشفرة
missions.description: Inspect captured packet evidence to discover credentials transmitted over cleartext HTTP.
missions.descriptionAr: فحص حزم البيانات الملتقطة واكتشاف بيانات اعتماد تم إرسالها دون تشفير عبر بروتوكول HTTP.
learningObjectives: Understand HTTP payload transmission without TLS
Filter HTTP POST authentication requests in packet dumps
Extract authentication tokens and leaked flags
missions.threatModel: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attackers on the local LAN or upstream path can passively intercept cleartext credentials.
missions.taskInstructions: Launch the PCAP Analyzer lab. Inspect `/home/analyst/evidence.pcap` using `cat` or `grep "ROGUE"` to discover the unencrypted auth flag.
missions.taskInstructionsAr: قم بتشغيل معمل فحص PCAP. افحص الملف `/home/analyst/evidence.pcap` واستخرج راية التسريب.
missions.remediationGuidance: Enforce HTTPS everywhere with HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) and modern TLS 1.3 ciphers.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Identify Unexpected C2 Network Traffic
missions.titleAr: كشف حركة مرور قيادة وتحكم (C2) المشبوهة
missions.description: Identify the destination IP and port used by an infected host beaconing out to an external C2 server.
missions.descriptionAr: تحديد عنوان IP والمنفذ المستخدمين من جهاز مصاب يتصل بخادم قيادة وتحكم خارجي.
learningObjectives: Recognize outbound C2 beaconing signatures
Distinguish internal trusted communication from suspicious outbound connections
Correlate non-standard ports (e.g. 4444) with known adversary frameworks
missions.threatModel: Adversaries establish outbound Command and Control (C2) channels to maintain persistence and receive interactive tasking.
missions.taskInstructions: In the PCAP lab, identify packet PKT#8 which shows an outbound connection to an external C2 IP. Enter the external destination IP address (e.g., 198.51.100.44).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: في معمل PCAP، حدد الحزمة PKT#8 التي تتصل بخادم خارجي C2. أدخل عنوان IP الخارجي المستهدف.

hints.title: Look at packet 8
hints.content: Check the destination IP in PKT#8 connecting to port 4444.

missions.remediationGuidance: Implement strict egress firewall filtering (deny all outbound except via monitored forward proxy).
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Interpret Nmap Port Scan & Backdoor Discovery
missions.titleAr: تحليل نتائج فحص المنافذ Nmap واكتشاف باب خلفي
missions.description: Analyze an Nmap service scan report and extract the flag hidden inside the vulnerable FTP service.
missions.descriptionAr: تحليل تقرير فحص منافذ Nmap واكتشاف خدمة FTP الملغمة بباب خلفي واستخراج الراية.
learningObjectives: Interpret Nmap service and version banner grabbing output
Identify historically backdoored software (vsftpd 2.3.4)
Analyze open attack surfaces on internal endpoints
missions.threatModel: Unpatched or malicious services running on default or non-standard ports provide direct initial access vectors.
missions.taskInstructions: Launch the Nmap lab. Read `/home/operator/target_scan.txt` to find the backdoor flag identified during the FTP audit.
missions.taskInstructionsAr: شغل معمل Nmap واقرأ تقرير `/home/operator/target_scan.txt` لاستخراج راية الباب الخلفي.
missions.remediationGuidance: Decommission legacy FTP services in favor of SFTP, and implement network vulnerability management scanners.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Identify Insecure SQL Query Construction
missions.titleAr: تحديد ثغرة حقن أوامر SQL البرمجية
missions.description: Examine vulnerable authentication source code and trigger a classic authentication bypass.
missions.descriptionAr: فحص الكود المصدري لنظام تسجيل الدخول وتنفيذ تجاوز للمصادقة عبر ثغرة SQLi.
learningObjectives: Identify SQL concatenation vulnerabilities in Python/SQLite
Craft SQL tautology injection payloads (`' OR '1'='1' -- `)
Extract database flag from administrative user records
missions.threatModel: SQL injection allows attackers to bypass authentication, read confidential tables, modify data, and potentially execute OS commands.
missions.taskInstructions: Launch the SQLi lab. Inspect `/var/www/app/schema.sql` and `/var/www/app/auth.py`. Retrieve the administrator account flag.
missions.taskInstructionsAr: شغل معمل SQLi. افحص كود `/var/www/app/schema.sql` واستخرج راية حساب المدير المخزنة في قاعدة البيانات.
missions.remediationGuidance: Always utilize parameterized prepared statements or modern ORMs like Prisma; never concatenate raw user input into SQL queries.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Diagnose Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
missions.titleAr: تشخيص ثغرة البرمجة عبر المواقع المخزنة (Stored XSS)
missions.description: Analyze an insecure comment system that fails to sanitize HTML characters before rendering in victim browsers.
missions.descriptionAr: تحليل نظام تعليقات يعاني من قصور في فلترة وسوم HTML مما يسمح بتنفيذ شفرات جافاسكريبت خبيثة.
learningObjectives: Distinguish Stored XSS from Reflected XSS
Identify the critical dangerous browser sinking functions (innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML)
Specify the standard defensive HTML entity encoding mechanism
missions.threatModel: Stored XSS allows an attacker to hijack user sessions, steal session cookies, and perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the victim.
missions.taskInstructions: What is the primary defensive function or concept in modern web frameworks used to neutralize HTML injection characters (<, >, &, ")? (Enter: HTML Entity Encoding or Context-Aware Escaping).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: ما هو المفهوم الدفاعي الأساسي المستخدم لتحييد وتطهير محارف HTML الخاصة في المتصفح؟ (أدخل مثلاً: HTML Entity Encoding).

hints.title: Keyword hint
hints.content: Answer contains "Encoding" or "Escaping" (e.g. HTML Entity Encoding or Context-Aware Escaping).

missions.remediationGuidance: Implement context-aware output encoding, strict Content Security Policy (CSP), and utilize modern frameworks that escape variables by default.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Detect Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
missions.titleAr: اكتشاف ثغرة المرجع المباشر غير الآمن للكائنات (IDOR)
missions.description: Analyze multi-tenant API endpoints that verify authentication but fail to enforce tenant authorization checks.
missions.descriptionAr: تحليل واجهة برمجية API تفحص تسجيل الدخول ولكنها تفشل في التحقق من صلاحية وصول المستخدم للكائن المطلوب.
learningObjectives: Differentiate between Authentication (Who you are) and Authorization (What you can access)
Detect horizontal privilege escalation via sequential numeric IDs
Implement object-level access control guards
missions.threatModel: An attacker changing `/api/documents/1042` to `/api/documents/1043` downloads confidential medical or financial records belonging to another customer.
missions.taskInstructions: Suppose an endpoint `GET /api/v1/invoices/:id` returns invoice data. What missing server-side check causes an IDOR vulnerability? (Enter: Object Ownership Verification or Tenant Authorization Check).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: ما هو الفحص البرمجي المفقود في الخادم الذي يسبب ثغرة IDOR عند جلب الفواتير؟ (أدخل مثلاً: Object Ownership Verification).

hints.title: Defensive concept
hints.content: Enter: Object Ownership Verification or Tenant Authorization Check.

missions.remediationGuidance: Always check if the currently authenticated `userId` owns the requested entity before returning records: `WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :current_user_id`.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Verify CSRF Defense Implementation
missions.titleAr: التحقق من كفاءة حماية التزوير عبر المواقع (CSRF)
missions.description: Verify the effectiveness of Anti-CSRF tokens and SameSite cookie attributes against state-changing attacks.
missions.descriptionAr: التحقق من عمل رموز مكافحة CSRF وخصائص ملفات تعريف الارتباط SameSite لحماية العمليات الحساسة.
learningObjectives: Understand how Cross-Site Request Forgery exploits automatic browser cookie transmission
Validate Double Submit Cookie and Synchronizer Token patterns
Configure `SameSite=Strict` or `SameSite=Lax` cookies
missions.threatModel: Victims clicking a malicious link automatically submit POST requests that transfer funds or change email addresses.
missions.taskInstructions: Which modern cookie attribute prevents the browser from sending cookies on cross-site state-changing requests? (Enter: SameSite=Strict or SameSite).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: ما هي خاصية ملف تعريف الارتباط (Cookie Attribute) الحديثة التي تمنع المتصفح من إرسال الكوكيز في الطلبات العابرة للمواقع؟
missions.remediationGuidance: Combine cryptographically random per-session anti-CSRF tokens with `SameSite=Strict` and `HttpOnly; Secure` cookies.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Investigate Suspicious Login Events
missions.titleAr: التحقيق في أحداث تسجيل الدخول المشبوهة
missions.description: Correlate anomalous login attempts across geographic origins and impossible travel velocities.
missions.descriptionAr: تحليل محاولات تسجيل دخول غير طبيعية ومقارنة المواقع الجغرافية وسرعة الانتقال المستحيلة.
learningObjectives: Identify Impossible Travel indicators
Correlate authentication timestamps with GeoIP coordinates
Trigger automated conditional access step-up MFA
missions.threatModel: Stolen credentials being reused from foreign exit nodes or proxy networks.
missions.taskInstructions: An employee logs in from London, UK at 10:00 AM UTC, and then from Tokyo, Japan at 10:25 AM UTC using the same account. What security detection indicator does this represent? (Enter: Impossible Travel).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: يسجل موظف دخوله من لندن الساعة 10:00 صباحاً ثم من طوكيو الساعة 10:25 صباحاً بنفس الحساب. ما هو اسم مؤشر الاكتشاف الأمني لهذا الحدث؟
missions.remediationGuidance: Deploy adaptive Risk-Based Conditional Access that automatically requires FIDO2/MFA or denies access when impossible velocity is detected.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Identify Threat Indicators in Synthetic Incident Logs
missions.titleAr: تحديد مؤشرات التهديد في سجلات الحوادث الاصطناعية
missions.description: Extract malicious Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) such as base64-encoded PowerShell payloads from SIEM event logs.
missions.descriptionAr: استخراج مؤشرات الاختراق (IOCs) مثل أوامر PowerShell المشفرة بقاعدة Base64 من سجلات SIEM.
learningObjectives: Parse JSON-formatted SIEM process creation events (Event ID 4688)
Decode malicious Base64 command lines
Extract C2 domain or IP artifacts into structured threat intelligence format
missions.threatModel: Attackers invoke Word macro documents that spawn hidden PowerShell download cradles communicating with remote C2 domains.
missions.taskInstructions: Launch the SIEM Studio lab. Inspect `/var/log/siem/incident_events.json`. Decode the base64 PowerShell command line in event SEC-4688 to find the C2 URL. Submit a structured JSON report with keys: `event_id`, `parent_process`, `c2_url`. Example: {"event_id": "SEC-4688", "parent_process": "WINWORD.EXE", "c2_url": "http://c2.roguebyte.lab/rev.ps1"}
missions.taskInstructionsAr: شغل معمل SIEM. افحص `/var/log/siem/incident_events.json`. قم بفك تشفير Base64 لأمر PowerShell لمعرفة رابط C2. أرسل تقرير JSON منظم يحتوي على المفاتيح: `event_id`, `parent_process`, `c2_url`.

hints.title: Inspection & base64 decode
hints.content: Run `cat /var/log/siem/incident_events.json` and decode the base64 string using: echo "<base64>" | base64 -d.

missions.remediationGuidance: Block Word from spawning child processes via Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules and deploy PowerShell Constrained Language Mode.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Write and Test a Detection Rule
missions.titleAr: كتابة واختبار قاعدة كشف تهديدات (Sigma Rule)
missions.description: Inspect the provided Sigma detection rule in the live SIEM sandbox and verify its critical severity classification.
missions.descriptionAr: فحص قاعدة كشف Sigma المتوفرة في المعمل والتأكد من تطابق معايير الكشف والتصنيف الأمني.
learningObjectives: Write vendor-neutral Sigma detection rules for Windows Event IDs
Map telemetry events to MITRE ATT&CK techniques (T1059.001)
Assign severity levels based on business risk
missions.threatModel: Without robust detection rules, commodity malware execution goes undetected for hundreds of days.
missions.taskInstructions: In the SIEM lab, read `/home/soc/sigma_template.yml`. What MITRE ATT&CK technique tag is mapped in the detection rule? (Enter: attack.t1059.001).
missions.taskInstructionsAr: في معمل SIEM، اقرأ `/home/soc/sigma_template.yml`. ما هو وسم تقنية MITRE ATT&CK المرفق في القاعدة؟ (أدخل مثلاً: attack.t1059.001).
missions.remediationGuidance: Continuously integrate automated CI/CD pipelines to validate Sigma rules against synthetic threat datasets.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz

missions.title: Produce Security Incident Triage Report
missions.titleAr: إعداد تقرير فني لفرز حادث أمني
missions.description: Produce an incident triage report documenting the root cause, affected assets, and immediate containment recommendations.
missions.descriptionAr: إعداد تقرير فني شامل يوثق السبب الجذري للحادث، الأصول المتضررة، وتوصيات الاحتواء العاجلة.
learningObjectives: Structure an executive and technical cybersecurity incident report
Document Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
Propose immediate containment and long-term eradication steps
missions.threatModel: Incomplete incident documentation leads to premature closure and re-infection by persistent adversaries.
missions.taskInstructions: Submit a comprehensive Incident Report (minimum 80 words) summarizing the PowerShell malicious macro incident. Must include the sections: [Executive Summary], [Root Cause], [Containment Actions], and [Long-term Hardening].
missions.taskInstructionsAr: أرسل تقريراً شاملاً لفرز الحادث (بحد أدنى 80 كلمة) يغطي حادث ماكرو وورد و PowerShell. يجب أن يتضمن: [Executive Summary], [Root Cause], [Containment Actions], [Long-term Hardening].

hints.title: Required sections
hints.content: Ensure your report contains the headers: Executive Summary, Root Cause, Containment Actions, Long-term Hardening and at least 80 words.

missions.remediationGuidance: Establish an Incident Response Playbook aligned with NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2.
missions.author: SidoDev-Dz
